subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Kerinci Seblat National Park is located in western Indonesia.
• It covers an area of 5,200 square miles (mi²).
• Khao Sok National Park is located in southern Thailand.
• It covers an area of 285 mi².
• These forest reserves are two of the many "biodiversity hotspots" in Southeast Asia.
• A biodiversity hotspot is a protected forest area with exceptionally high concentrations of endemic species.
prompt: The student wants to compare the sizes of the two forest reserves. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: There are many protected forest areas located in Southeast Asia.
choices.B: Kerinci Seblat National Park and Khao Sok National Park are both protected forest areas with exceptionally high concentrations of endemic species.
choices.C: Biodiversity hotspots in Southeast Asia can vary in size.
choices.D: In terms of area, Kerinci Seblat National Park (which covers 5,200 mi²) is larger than Khao Sok National Park (285 mi²).

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it most effectively accomplishes the goal of comparing the sizes of the two forest reserves. The sentence names both parks, provides their specific area measurements (5,200 mi² and 285 mi²), and uses explicit comparative language ('is larger than') to establish a clear relationship between their sizes. By presenting concrete numerical data within a comparative framework, this choice directly addresses the student's rhetorical purpose of demonstrating the size difference between Kerinci Seblat National Park and Khao Sok National Park.
